adjudication: Authored semantic gold; LLM-assisted manual review, not independently blinded human labels. Held out from tuning, not from authoring.
rules: Gold never enters engine/model input. Review extra claims, identity metadata and every stored item at every batch, not just expected facts.
Checkpoint required meanings are cumulative current expectations; meaningful prior states are explicitly included. Judge meaning rather than field names or phrasing.

An erroneous current value before a later correction is supported as what the user reported at that time. After correction it must not become a fabricated real historical event. Existing history is immutable.
Questions and assistant suggestions are not user assertions. Assistant proposals and unconfirmed hypotheses must not become confirmed facts.
Approximate dates and qualified schedules stay qualified. Confidence concerns support in user statements, not external truth.
Read query_relevant_memories separately from background_memories. Unknown queries must not acquire fabricated evidence; an unrelated candidate is a relevance error.
Required/optional misses, wrong propositions, identity errors, history errors and unresolved judgments are separate counts. Later success cannot erase earlier failure.
Use the frozen progression thresholds in the evaluation plan; do not tune on held-out validation. Preserve failures and mark consumed validation cases after any resulting fix.
